parameters.name: clientToken
parameters.description: A unique token that is used to ensure idempotency. This token is generated by the client and must be unique across different requests. The token can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length.

parameters.name: deleteType
parameters.description:
The release type. Valid values:

- immediate: immediately deletes the instance. After deletion, the system permanently clears all data, and the instance no longer appears in the instance list.
- protective: freezes the instance for 24 hours before permanently clearing the data. During this period, the instance still appears in the instance list. You can choose to [recover the instance](~~202205~~) or [immediately release it](~~160591~~).
